glossary.definition: A step-by-step marketing process designed to convert visitors into customers. Systeme.io's funnel builder creates landing pages with forms, payments, and automation triggers.
Automated email sequences triggered by specific actions or conditions. Systeme.io's visual workflow builder makes email automation simple for beginners.
An automated sequence of emails sent on a schedule or triggered by actions. Systeme.io's drip campaigns nurture leads over time without manual follow-up.
The process of collecting visitor information through forms and landing pages. Systeme.io captures leads through funnels, opt-in forms, and webinar registration pages.
Offering a higher-value product after a purchase. Systeme.io supports one-click upsells and downsells to maximize revenue per customer.

A single-page mobile-optimized storefront you can link from your social media bio. Systeme.io's creator store lets you sell courses, digital products, and downloads — replacing Linktree, Stan Store, or Gumroad.
A pre-recorded webinar that runs automatically on a schedule. Systeme.io's evergreen webinar system lets you sell on autopilot 24/7.
A system where affiliates promote your products for a commission. Systeme.io's built-in affiliate management lets you recruit and track affiliates without third-party tools.
Labels applied to contacts for segmentation. Systeme.io's tagging system lets you organize subscribers by interest, behavior, or purchase history for targeted campaigns.
A set of automated actions triggered by events. Systeme.io's visual workflow builder uses triggers, conditions, and actions to automate repetitive marketing tasks.
Testing two versions of a page to see which performs better. Systeme.io's built-in A/B testing optimizes your funnels for maximum conversions.
A gated area with tiered access to content. Systeme.io's membership features support recurring billing, drip content, and community discussion areas.
